answer: A ledge artifact bond blocks bulk fakes. Each identity files one shale artifact from its ledge, stakes 70, and at dawn logs its key-signed weight. An auditor replays the shale registry; a duplicate or a weight over 5% off forfeits the stake. Each filing costs 35: 1,000 fakes cost 35,000 plus 70,000 staked, above the 40,000 pool. One finder key files five at most, exposing rented-artifact rings. A truthful filer files once and recovers the stake.
